entry_contract: Continue from 92 Shadowmoon Valley, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in Shadowmoon Valley with Mordenai. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from Shattrath City to Shadowmoon Valley. Use a known flight path when it saves time; otherwise follow roads and zone connections. Continue to [G59.19,58.69 Shadowmoon Valley]. [O]
